title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Putting an Additional Driver Charge on a Rental
content:
Where additional drivers are named on a car rental agreement beyond those the agreement carries free of charge, an additional driver charge falls due on that rental and is put onto the rental's own ledger. The result this basis governs is the money charged for those drivers on that agreement, and the observable effect is a single additional driver entry standing on the agreement, billed to the card held against the rental. The charge belongs to the rental that carries the drivers; a driver named on two rentals at once gives rise to a charge on each.

**The action the desk takes.** The desk raises one additional driver line against the rental, at the money it has worked out from the published terms of the Car Rental Rate Classes and the rental's own records.

**How the tool is reached.** The tool `charge_additional_driver_79b211ed` is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it. One call raises a single additional driver line against the rental for the drivers named on the agreement beyond the ones it carries free, at the amount supplied.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `drive_rental_id` | The reference number of the car rental agreement the charge belongs to, as it stands on the rental record returned by the car rental lookup | An identifier |
| `additional_driver_charge_usd` | The money charged for the additional drivers named on the agreement | A positive amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the last step only, carrying no currency symbol and no thousands separator |

**Return.** The call comes back with a confirmation sentence naming the reference of the additional driver ledger line just raised, the rental agreement it was raised against, and the amount in US dollars to two decimal places that now stands on the ledger. Any other text means the line was not raised.
